checkedAlternates.risk: Skeleton uses the same sliding track as luge and bobsleigh.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Skeleton riders slide prone head-first (group-1), distinct from seated bobsleigh and supine feet-first luge (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Ice dance uses skating blades on an oval rink.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Ice dance is an artistic judged discipline (group-3), not a timed race (group-4).
